socialSecurity.title: Partisan Entrepreneurship
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Republicans start more firms than Democrats. In a sample of 40 million party‐identified Americans between 2005 and 2017, we find that 5.5% of Republicans and 3.7% of Democrats become entrepreneurs. This partisan entrepreneurship gap is time‐varying—Republicans increase their relative entrepreneurship during Republican administrations and decrease it during Democratic administrations, amounting to a partisan reallocation of 170,000 new firms over our 13‐year sample. We find sharp changes in partisan entrepreneurship around the elections of President Obama and President Trump, with the strongest effects among the most politically active partisans: those that donate and vote.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 党派创业
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 共和党人创办的企业多于民主党人。在2005年至2017年间4,000万名有党派身份的美国人样本中，我们发现5.5%的共和党人和3.7%的民主党人成为创业者。这种党派创业差距随时间变化——共和党执政期间，共和党人的相对创业率上升；民主党执政期间，则相对下降，在13年样本中累计造成了17万家新企业的党派再分配。我们发现，在奥巴马总统和特朗普总统选举前后，党派创业发生了急剧变化，且在政治活动最积极的党派支持者（即那些进行捐款和投票的人）中效应最为显著。

socialSecurity.title: Private Equity and Pay Gaps Inside the Firm
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Using two decades of French administrative data, we find that post‐leveraged buyout (LBO), target firms reduce within‐firm pay gaps while increasing profitability relative to control firms. Employee turnover drives the pay‐gap reduction. In target and control firms alike, turnovers reduce average pay more at the top of the wage distribution than at the bottom because separated employees are paid more—new joiners less—than similar employees, especially among skilled employees. LBOs amplify this effect through increased turnover among managers. Post‐buyout, p90/p10, gender, age, and managers/non‐managers pay gaps decline by 3%, 9%, 21%, and 4% and the employee pool becomes younger.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 私募股权与公司内部薪酬差距
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 利用法国行政数据近二十年的研究，我们发现，在杠杆收购（LBO）之后，目标企业相较于对照企业缩小了公司内部的薪酬差距，同时提升了盈利能力。员工流动是导致薪酬差距缩小的重要原因。在目标企业和对照企业中，员工流动均使工资分布顶端的平均薪酬降幅大于底端，因为离职员工的薪酬高于留任员工，而新入职员工的薪酬则低于类似员工，这一现象在高技能员工中尤为明显。杠杆收购通过增加管理人员流动放大了上述效应。收购完成后，第90百分位/第10百分位薪酬比、性别薪酬差距、年龄薪酬差距以及管理人员与非管理人员间的薪酬差距分别下降了3%、9%、21%和4%，且员工队伍整体趋于年轻化。

socialSecurity.title: Consumption in Asset Returns
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Using information in returns, we identify the stochastic process of consumption. We find that aggregate consumption reacts over multiple quarters to innovations spanned by financial markets. This persistent component accounts for over a quarter of consumption variation. These shocks command a large and significant risk premium, driving a large share of stocks' and a small yet significant fraction of bonds' time‐series variation. Nevertheless, we find no support for stochastic volatility of consumption driving time‐varying risk premia. Finally, an otherwise standard recursive utility model based on our estimated process explains equity premium and risk‐free rate puzzles with low‐risk aversion.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 资产收益中的消费
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文利用收益中的信息识别消费随机过程。研究发现，总消费对金融市场所张成的创新在多个季度内作出反应。该持久性成分解释了消费变动的四分之一以上。这些冲击要求较大且显著的风险溢价，驱动了股票时间序列变动的较大份额以及债券时间序列变动的较小但显著的份额。然而，本文未发现支持消费随机波动率驱动时变风险溢价的证据。最后，基于所估计过程的一个标准递归效用模型以低风险厌恶水平解释了股权溢价与无风险利率之谜。

socialSecurity.title: Risk‐Free Rates and Convenience Yields around the World
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We infer risk‐free rates from index option prices to estimate safe asset convenience yields in 10 G11 currencies. Countries' convenience yields increase with the level of their interest rates, with U.S. convenience yields fifth largest. During financial crises, convenience yields grow, but the difference between United States and foreign convenience yields generally does not. Covered interest parity (CIP) deviations using our option‐implied rates are a similar size between the United States and each other country. A model in which convenience yields depend on domestic financial intermediaries, but CIP deviations reflect the funding costs of international arbitrageurs financed with dollar‐denominated debt, explains these results.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 全球无风险利率与便利收益率
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们从指数期权价格中推断无风险利率，以估算十国集团（G11）货币中安全资产的便利收益率。各国便利收益率随其利率水平的上升而增加，其中美国的便利收益率排名第五。在金融危机期间，便利收益率上升，但美国与外国便利收益率之间的差异总体上并未扩大。利用我们基于期权推算的利率所衡量的抛补利率平价（ CIP）偏差在美国与每个其他国家之间规模相近。一个模型可以解释这些结果：在该模型中，便利收益率取决于国内金融中介机构，而 CIP 偏差则反映了以美元计价债务融资的国际套利者的资金成本。

socialSecurity.title: Detecting Informed Trading Risk from Undercutting Activity
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We introduce a simple measure of informed trading risk, , the residual to liquidity quote‐improvement‐to‐deterioration ratio times . When facing with increased informed trading risk, liquidity providers compete less to provide liquidity, reducing their undercutting activity. Reductions in undercutting leave footprints in trade and quote data that are captured by . Unlike prior measures,  is easy to construct, can be computed intraday, and is orthogonal to liquidity. The  measure outperforms prominent existing alternatives in reflecting the extent of information asymmetry before earnings announcements, predicting unscheduled press releases, and identifying informed trading spillovers around them.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 基于削价交易活动检测知情交易风险
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
                  我们提出了一种简单的知情交易风险测度 ，即流动性报价改善与恶化比率乘以 的残差。当面临上升的知情交易风险时，流动性提供者为提供流动性而展开的竞争减弱，从而降低了其削价交易活动。削价活动的减少在交易和报价数据中留下了可被 所捕捉的痕迹。与已有测度不同， 易于构建，可日内计算，并且与流动性正交。 在反映盈利公告前信息不对称程度、预测非计划新闻发布以及识别其周围的知情交易溢出效应方面，表现优于现有主流替代指标。

socialSecurity.title: Quote Competition in Corporate Bonds
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Dealer quotes in corporate bonds, though indicative, lower trading costs and increase trading volume. Dealers offering higher quality quotes attract more order flow and execute trades at favorable prices. Dealers advertise quotes to manage their inventories and attract orders from nonrelationship clients. However, quote competition is imperfect. The best quotes often fail to attract orders, and trade‐throughs are common. Nevertheless, quote competition is important as clients exploit quotes from other dealers in negotiations, forcing dealers with lower quality quotes to offer price improvements. Quoting is not a zero‐sum game, as more active bond‐level quoting leads to more bond‐level trading.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 企业债券中的报价竞争
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：企业债券市场中交易商的报价虽仅为指示性报价，但能降低交易成本并增加交易量。提供更高质量报价的交易商能够吸引更多订单流，并以有利价格达成交易。交易商通过公开报价来管理其存货并吸引与非关系客户的订单。然而，报价竞争是不完全的。最佳报价往往无法吸引订单，穿越报价现象（trade‐throughs）也较为常见。尽管如此，报价竞争仍具有重要意义，因为客户会在谈判中利用其他交易商的报价，迫使报价质量较差的交易商提供价格改善。报价行为并非零和博弈，债券层面更为活跃的报价会带来该债券层面更多的交易活动。

socialSecurity.title: The Drivers and Implications of Retail Margin Trading
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Using granular data covering both regulated (brokerage‐financed) and unregulated (shadow‐financed) margin accounts in China, we provide novel evidence on retail investors' margin trading behavior and its price implications. We first show that retail investors' decisions to lever up in stock trading despite the hefty borrowing cost is related to their lottery preferences. We then show that margin borrowing affects investors' trading behavior—investors are more likely to liquidate their holdings as they approach margin calls. Finally, we show that margin‐induced trading aggregates to affect asset prices and contributes to shock spillovers across stocks (e.g., from lottery stocks to nonlottery stocks).
socialSecurity.titleZh: 零售保证金交易的驱动因素与影响
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 基于涵盖中国受监管（券商融资）和不受监管（影子融资）保证金账户的精细数据，我们提供了关于零售投资者保证金交易行为及其价格影响的新证据。我们首先表明，尽管借款成本高昂，零售投资者在股票交易中加杠杆的决定与其彩票偏好有关。随后我们表明，保证金借款会影响投资者的交易行为——投资者在接近追保通知时更倾向于平仓其持仓。最后我们表明，保证金诱发的交易会聚合并影响资产价格，且会导致股票之间的冲击溢出（例如，从彩票型股票溢出至非彩票型股票）。

socialSecurity.title: Why Have CEO Pay Levels Become Less Diverse?
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper documents a new stylized fact: the cross‐sectional variation in CEO pay levels has declined precipitously in recent years. We offer one explanation for this decline, namely, firms are increasingly benchmarking CEO compensation to industry peers closest in size, thereby creating pay clusters. Our empirical tests provide support for this explanation and suggest that the rise of industry‐size benchmarking is driven by three institutional factors: the mandatory disclosure of compensation peer groups, proxy advisory influence, and say‐on‐pay regulation. Our findings highlight a consequence of adopting a one‐size‐fits‐all standard in the pay‐setting process.
socialSecurity.titleZh: Why Have CEO Pay Levels Become Less Diverse?

socialSecurity.title: Hedger of Last Resort: Evidence from Brazilian FX Interventions, Local Credit, and Global Financial Cycles
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    We show that FX interventions can be effective, particularly in attenuating global financial spillovers. We exploit global financial shocks and Brazilian central bank interventions in FX derivatives using three matched administrative registers: bank credit (to firms), foreign credit to banks, and employer‐employees. After the U.S. Taper Tantrum (followed by emerging markets' FX turbulence), Brazilian banks with more foreign debt cut credit supply, reducing firm‐level employment. A subsequent large policy intervention supplying derivatives against FX risks —
                    hedger of last resort
                    — halved the negative effects. A 2008 to 2015 panel exploiting global FX shocks and local FX interventions confirms the results and the hedging channel. However, the FX policy entails fiscal and moral hazard costs.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 最后对冲者：来自巴西外汇干预、本地信贷与全球金融周期的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文表明，外汇干预能够发挥有效作用，尤其在缓解全球金融溢出效应方面。我们利用全球金融冲击与巴西央行在外汇衍生品市场的干预，并结合三套匹配的行政登记数据——银行对企业贷款、银行的外币信贷以及雇主—雇员关系数据——展开分析。在美国"缩减恐慌"事件之后（伴随着新兴市场的外汇动荡），持有较多外债的巴西银行削减了信贷供给，从而导致企业层面的就业下降。随后，一项通过提供防范外汇风险衍生品的大规模政策干预——即"最后对冲者"——将上述负面效应削减了一半。利用2008至2015年面板数据考察全球外汇冲击与本地外汇交互动的检验进一步证实了上述结论与对冲渠道。然而，外汇政策也伴随着财政成本与道德风险。

socialSecurity.title: Investing with Purpose: Evidence from Private Foundations
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We study the asset allocation and investment performance of U.S. private foundations that support the charitable sector. Large foundations generated positive risk‐adjusted returns before 2008, driven by early access to private equity and venture capital funds, but have underperformed since. The median foundation underperforms by more than 100 bps. Foundations with concentrated stock holdings achieve higher returns but assume more risk. Due to the constraints imposed by the 5% minimum spending rule and accommodating monetary policy, foundations increase risk‐taking and reach for yield. Over time, a conservative asset allocation decreases real wealth, reducing charitable giving.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 有目的的投资：来自私人基金会的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究了美国支持慈善事业的私人基金会的资产配置与投资业绩。大型基金会在2008年之前凭借早期进入私募股权和风险投资基金的机会，获得了正向的风险调整后收益，但此后表现欠佳。中位数基金会的业绩落后逾100个基点。集中持有股票的基金会虽能获得更高收益，但也承担了更多风险。由于5%最低支出规则的约束以及宽松货币政策的推动，基金会倾向于提高风险承担并追逐收益。随着时间推移，保守的资产配置导致实际财富下降，进而削弱了慈善捐赠能力。

socialSecurity.title: Cash Heterogeneity and the Payout Channel of Monetary Policy
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper provides novel empirical evidence that cash‐rich firms have higher equity payouts and higher stock prices in response to expansionary monetary policy surprises. Stock prices rise despite weak cash‐flow, investment, and credit responses to monetary policy. I rationalize the empirical evidence in a heterogeneous‐firm New Keynesian model where firms finance investment with cash and equity issuance. Monetary easing weakens precautionary cash demand, leading cash‐rich firms to optimally allocate excess funds to shareholders. Since payouts are procyclical, cash‐rich firms earn higher returns in expansionary periods. My findings highlight a payout channel through which monetary policy impacts asset prices.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 现金异质性与货币政策的派息渠道
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文提供了新的经验证据，表明在扩张性货币政策意外冲击下，现金充裕企业的股权派息和股价均显著上升。尽管货币政策的现金流、投资及信贷反应较为疲弱，股价仍出现上涨。作者在一个具有企业异质性的新凯恩斯主义模型中对该经验证据加以解释：企业以现金和股权发行融资进行投资；货币宽松削弱了预防性现金需求，从而使现金充裕企业将多余资金最优地分配给股东。由于派息具有顺周期性，现金充裕企业在扩张期能获得更高回报。本文的发现揭示了货币政策通过派息渠道影响资产价格的机制。

socialSecurity.title: The Debt‐Equity Spread
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    We propose a measure of the valuation gap between debt and equity—debt‐equity spread (DES)—based on the difference between actual and equity‐implied credit spreads. DES predicts cross‐sectional stock and bond returns in opposite directions. This predictability is unique compared to existing mispricing measures and cannot be explained by exposures to various risk factors. High‐DES firms are more likely to issue equity and retire debt, and have more insider equity selling. These findings are consistent with DES capturing relative mispricing between debt and equity, and provide empirical support for the model of partially segmented markets in Greenwood, Hanson, and Liao (2018,
                    Review of Financial Studies
                    31, 3307–3343).
socialSecurity.titleZh: 债务-股权利差
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种衡量债务与股权之间估值差距的指标——债务-股权利差（DES），其基于实际信用利差与股权隐含信用利差之间的差异。DES 对横截面股票和债券收益的预测方向相反。相较于现有的错误定价指标，这种预测能力是独特的，且无法被对各类风险因子的暴露所解释。高 DES 的公司更可能发行股票并赎回债务，且内部人股票卖出更多。上述发现与 DES 捕捉债务与股权之间的相对错误定价相一致，并为 Greenwood、Hanson 与 Liao（2018，《金融研究评论》第 31 卷，第 3307–3343 页）所提出的部分分割市场模型提供了实证支持。

socialSecurity.title: Bank Competition Amid Digital Disruption: Implications for Financial Inclusion
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We examine how digital disruption affects bank competition using the staggered rollout of 3G mobile networks. 3G expansion increased mobile banking adoption among tech‐savvy households, reducing branch networks—especially in younger counties. Banks' strategies diverged: Less branch‐reliant banks closed branches and competed on price, while more branch‐reliant banks maintained branches but raised spreads. A structural model shows that perceived digital service improvements among younger consumers drove these shifts, reducing welfare for older savers. Counterfactuals demonstrate that subsidizing adoption for older savers can cost‐effectively reduce these disparities, facilitating a smoother digital transition.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 数字冲击下的银行竞争：对普惠金融的影响
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
                  本文利用3G移动网络的渐进式铺开，考察数字冲击如何影响银行竞争。3G网络的扩展提高了精通技术的家庭对移动银行的采用，并导致银行网点收缩——这一现象在年轻人口占比较高的县尤为明显。银行的应对策略出现分化：对网点依赖度较低的银行关闭网点并展开价格竞争，而对网点依赖度较高的银行则保留网点但扩大存贷利差。一个结构模型显示，年轻消费者对数字服务改善的感知推动了上述转变，但降低了年长储户的福利。反事实分析表明，对年长储户的数字服务采用进行补贴能够以较低成本缩小这些差距，从而促进更为平稳的数字化转型。

socialSecurity.title: Finance and product markets
socialSecurity.abstract: The nature of product market competition and its influence on firms’ decisions have a long history in economics. Competition was discussed by Adam Smith in The Wealth of Nations. George Stigler received the Nobel Prize in 1982 for his seminal studies of industrial structure, the functioning of markets, and the causes and effects of public regulation. This long-standing interest stems from a simple fact: firms do not operate in isolation but interact within product markets. socialSecurity.titleZh: 金融与产品市场
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 产品市场竞争的性质及其对企业决策的影响在经济学中有着悠久的历史。亚当·斯密在《国富论》中曾讨论过竞争问题。乔治·施蒂格勒因其对产业结构、市场运行以及公共监管的成因与影响的开创性研究，于1982年获得诺贝尔经济学奖。这一长期存在的关注源于一个简单的事实：企业并非孤立运作，而是在产品市场内相互作用。这些相互作用界定了市场的边界，塑造了市场动态，并决定了由此产生的竞争强度。

socialSecurity.title: Estimating Network Externalities in Undirected Link Formation Games
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper explores the existence of network externalities in link formation games of incomplete information. It extends the structural estimation method in Leung (2015) to games where links are undirected and proposals are only partially observed. We provide an econometric characterization of the proposed two‐step estimator and document its performance through a simulation exercise. When the estimation method is applied to data on risk‐sharing arrangements in a Tanzanian village, results indicate that indirect connections matter.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 无向链接形成博弈中网络外部性的估计
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文探讨了不完全信息下链接形成博弈中网络外部性的存在性问题。该研究将 Leung（2015）中的结构估计方法扩展至链接无向且提议仅被部分观察的博弈。我们对所提出的两步估计量进行了计量经济学刻画，并通过模拟实验记录其表现。当该估计方法被应用于坦桑尼亚一个村庄的风险分担安排数据时，结果表明间接联系具有重要作用。

socialSecurity.title: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.
socialSecurity.titleZh: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts

socialSecurity.title: Simultaneous and Sequential Competition With Asymmetric Information and Externalities
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper examines the joint role of strategic timing, asymmetric private demand and cost information, and common ownership in shaping equilibrium outcomes in oligopolistic markets. We develop a three‐firm model and study Cournot and Stackelberg competition. The main results are as follows. (1) Mover advantages are determined by relative signal precision: the leader benefits most when the second mover has a more precise signal, the second mover benefits most when the last mover has high signal precision, and the last mover benefits when both followers have sufficiently noisy signals. (2) Cournot competition generates greater consumer and total surplus and lower total profits than Stackelberg competition if neither follower has significantly higher signal precision than the leader. (3) Common ownership increases consumer and total surplus but reduces total profits in Stackelberg competition if and only if the last mover is not substantially better informed than the leader. These findings have implications for contests,  partnership, network, public good, common resource, and gas emission games with altruistic preferences. Since total profit in oligopoly models can be interpreted as aggregate welfare in these environments, the welfare rankings are reversed.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 信息不对称与外部性下的同时竞争与序贯竞争
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文考察了战略时序、私人需求与成本信息的不对称性以及共同所有权在塑造寡头市场均衡结果中的共同作用。我们构建了一个三企业模型，并研究古诺竞争与斯塔克伯格竞争。主要结果如下。（1）先动优势由相对信号精度决定：当第二行动者拥有更精确的信号时，领导者获益最大；当最后行动者具有高信号精度时，第二行动者获益最大；而当两个跟随者的信号都足够嘈杂时，最后行动者获益。（2）若两个跟随者的信号精度都不显著高于领导者，则古诺竞争产生的消费者剩余与总剩余高于斯塔克伯格竞争，而总利润则低于斯塔克伯格竞争。（3）在斯塔克伯格竞争中，当且仅当最后行动者并未显著比领导者拥有更多信息时，共同所有权才会提高消费者剩余与总剩余，同时降低总利润。这些发现对具有利他偏好的竞赛、合伙关系、网络、公共品、共享资源及碳排放博弈具有启示意义。由于寡头模型中的总利润在这些环境中可被解释为总体福利，因此福利排序将发生反转。

socialSecurity.title: Corporate Green Pledges
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. socialSecurity.abstract: 当前中国经济正面临“内卷式”竞争加剧与全要素生产率增速放缓并存的结构性矛盾。为此，本文构建包含分步式创新与内生策略选择的熊彼特增长模型，结合典型事实，刻画企业在高质量创新、低质量微创新与掠夺性定价间的权衡，并通过数值模拟考察微观策略偏离导致宏观增长放缓的内在机理。研究发现，激烈的同质化竞争、缺乏梯度的产权保护与数量导向型的支持政策共同扭曲了创新激励，促使企业转向低成本微创新或价格战，挤出颠覆性技术...

socialSecurity.abstract: 本文分析了我国权威型教养方式背后的社会经济动因，其与社会教育回报率和地区收入差距有直接联系。本文利用2005年人口抽样调查和多项微观调查数据，研究发现父母在26-40岁经历的教育回报率每提高1个百分点，其采取权威型教养方式的概率将提高1.21个百分点。地区收入差距会进一步扩大教育回报率对教养方式选择的影响，因为在收入差距越大的地区，父母越有动力严格要求子女，提高其教育水平，从而实现社会经济地位向上...

socialSecurity.title: Social Status, Inequality, and Redistribution
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We explore implications of social status concerns for redistribution, income inequality, and growth in a political economy framework. Salience of such concerns leads to a propagation mechanism, whereby initial income inequality and reduced willingness to redistribute income reinforce each other, potentially giving rise to multiple steady states. An extension illustrates the possibility of a high redistribution cum low inequality steady state resulting in a higher steady‐state income level. Some of the model features are shown to be consistent with empirical regularities as reflected in survey data on social status attitudes.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 社会地位、不平等与再分配
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们在政治经济学框架中探讨社会地位关切对再分配、收入不平等和经济增长的影响。此类关切的显著性导致一种传播机制，据此，初始收入不平等与较低的再分配意愿相互强化，可能产生多重稳态。一个扩展模型说明了高再分配与低不平等稳态可能带来更高稳态收入水平的可能性。模型的一些特征与调查数据中反映的关于社会地位态度的经验规律相一致。

socialSecurity.title: Home Production and Gender Gap in Structural Change
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 家庭生产与结构变迁中的性别差距
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文考察了发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距问题，该差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者中。家庭内部分工起着核心作用：已婚女性在家庭生产上投入更多时间，市场工作时长更短，且更不太可能承担进入非农部门的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含家庭联合决策、跨部门中性性别劳动楔子以及进入壁垒的一般均衡Roy模型。利用2010年中国数据进行校准后，模型成功再现了观察到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并因家庭内部分工而被进一步放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了差距从2000年到2010年间的扩大趋势。

socialSecurity.abstract: 中国制造业在经历长期的跨越式发展后，已连续多年保持全球第一制造大国地位，成功迈入制造强国行列，当前正步入加快建设制造强国的新征程。西方经典工业化理论难以适配中国复合型发展现实，亟须从理论层面系统阐释中国从制造大国迈向制造强国的内在逻辑与发展路径。本文基于中国制造业发展的典型事实，构建了涵盖逻辑主导层、动力供给层、实体承载层与生态适配层的结合型治理一般分析框架。针对“十五五”时期及更长远的高质量发展...

socialSecurity.title: 生态系统内的平台嵌套与平台型互补者的成长机制
socialSecurity.abstract: 大小平台嵌套的生态系统已成为数字时代全新的产业组织形态。然而，现有研究既缺乏对生态系统内平台嵌套异质性的解析，也未充分考虑平台型互补者生态嵌入后所面临的“一致性—拓展性”张力及其响应机制。本文采用双案例研究方法，识别出平台嵌套本质上是生态系统内主导平台与平台型互补者在共享技术架构、对接终端用户需求过程中形成的层次化价值耦合结构，并解构出功能嵌套与市场嵌套两种结构类型。研究发现，不同嵌套结构下，平台...

socialSecurity.title: 产业政策如何影响供应链关系变动——基于供应商转换机制的分析
socialSecurity.abstract: 在全球供应链日益复杂、经济不确定性上升的背景下，产业政策如何影响企业间供应链关系变动并塑造供应链韧性，成为亟待回答的重要问题。本文构建企业供应商转换决策的理论框架，分析产业政策影响供应链关系变动的机制。在实证层面，本文基于全球贸易预警数据库，结合BERT文本分析与机器学习方法构建中国产业政策指标，并利用FactSet Revere数据考察上市公司供应链关系。研究发现，产业政策能够降低企业供应商变动...

socialSecurity.title: 构建中国哲学社会科学自主知识体系的工业经济样本
socialSecurity.abstract: 加快构建中国哲学社会科学自主知识体系，是为中国式现代化提供学理支撑、打破西方话语权垄断的迫切需要，也是更好回答中国之问、世界之问、人民之问、时代之问的迫切需要。在党的创新理论引领下，中国工业经济发展取得了伟大成就，形成了构建中国工业经济自主知识体系的实践底气，同时，丰富的学术研究成果奠定了坚实的研究基础，使工业经济较好地满足了自主知识体系建构所需要的基本条件。中国社会科学院工业经济研究所开展的“中...

socialSecurity.title: 银行政府采购暴露对非采购企业信贷的影响——基于财政工具的货币效应视角
socialSecurity.abstract: 加强财政与货币政策协同是提升宏观经济治理效能的关键。政府采购作为重要的财政工具，与金融市场信贷配置密切相关。既有研究已证实政府采购对中标企业融资具有积极影响，但市场中还存在大量非采购企业，其信贷融资状况可能同样受到政府采购的溢出效应影响。本文利用银行—企业配对数据，构建银行的政府采购暴露度指标，系统检验政府采购对银行信贷的传导机制。研究发现，银行的政府采购暴露度会提升非采购企业的贷款规模。机制分析...

socialSecurity.title: 共同富裕进程中的数字政府建设：政务服务均等化与县域经济发展的视角
socialSecurity.abstract: 有效的政府治理是发挥社会主义市场经济体制优势的内在要求。本文从政府治理现代化视角，系统阐释了政务服务均等化在促进县域经济增速赶超和缓解区域发展不平衡方面的积极作用。基于《政府网站工作年度报表》与夜间灯光栅格数据的实证研究表明：数字政府建设降低了城市内部经济发展不平等水平，且这一效应主要源于区县间经济发展差距的缩小，特别是县（县级市）的经济增速，在数字政府建设影响下相对更快。机制分析显示，城市数字政...

socialSecurity.title: 产业转移如何促进企业异地合作创新——基于产业链供应链优化视角
socialSecurity.abstract: 产业转移会促进双方的产业升级，但产业转移对产业链供应链优化、企业合作创新的影响尚需进一步探讨。本文运用多期双重差分法，识别了产业转移示范区政策对企业异地合作创新的影响效应及作用机制。研究发现，产业转移示范区的设立，有效提升了当地企业异地合作专利数量。机制分析发现，产业转移示范区政策能够促进产业链优化、提高供应链稳定性，进而推动企业异地合作创新。异质性分析发现，该政策对创新信息披露程度较高的企业、所...

socialSecurity.title: 银行网络的气候转型风险溢出效应和宏观审慎政策
socialSecurity.abstract: 在全球低碳转型持续推进的背景下，气候转型风险正逐渐成为引发系统性金融风险的重要来源。基于此，本文系统考察气候转型风险在中国银行体系中的现实影响、传导机制及宏观审慎政策的缓释作用。研究发现，近年来气候转型风险已逐步转化为中国银行体系中可观测的新增资本压力；在企业碳排放强度差异显著的情形下，高碳企业的风险更容易沿银行网络扩散并引发连锁反应；在核心—边缘型银行网络结构中，碳风险敞口较高的核心银行通过同业...

socialSecurity.title: Strategic Stake Acquisitions in Rival Firms: Common vs. Cross‐Ownership
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    We study how a blockholder who controls a firm should acquire a minority stake in a rival: directly, creating
                    common ownership
                    , or indirectly through the controlled firm, creating
                    cross‐ownership
                    . Common ownership generates stronger internalization of competitive externalities and allows the blockholder to capture the resulting gains without sharing them with dispersed shareholders. However, it may also create conflicts of interest with minority shareholders that can lead to a loss of control. Cross‐ownership avoids this governance risk but internalizes competition less effectively. We characterize how the optimal acquisition mode depends on the nature of product market competition and the strength of corporate governance.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 在竞争对手企业中的战略性股权收购：共同持股与交叉持股
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究控制一家企业的大股东应如何收购其竞争对手的少数股权：是直接收购以形成共同持股，还是通过其所控制的企业间接收购以形成交叉持股。共同持股能够更强地内化竞争外部性，并使大股东能够在不与分散股东分享的情况下获取由此产生的收益。然而，共同持股也可能与少数股东产生利益冲突，从而导致控制权丧失的风险。交叉持股则规避了这一治理风险，但对竞争的内化效果较弱。本文刻画了最优收购方式如何取决于产品市场竞争的性质以及公司治理的强度。

socialSecurity.title: Identifying Peer Effects in Networks with Unobserved Effort and Isolated Students
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 在存在不可观测努力与孤立学生的网络中识别同伴效应
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：对于某项活动所投入努力的同伴影响研究，常常面临努力不可观测的问题，研究者只能观察到由努力与其他冲击共同决定的结果。例如，在教育领域，GPA等学业成绩指标同时反映了学生的努力程度和个体特有的GAA冲击。本文提出了一种替代方法以避免此类近似处理。我们的框架将不影响努力的GPA冲击与影响努力水平的偏好冲击加以区分。我们证明，当网络中包含孤立学生时，使用本文方法得到的同伴效应估计与经典方法（以近似方式处理努力）所得结果可能存在显著差异。将本文方法应用于美国高中学生数据，我们发现，以GPA作为努力代理变量所得到的同伴效应估计比本文方法低40%。

socialSecurity.title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
socialSecurity.titleZh: Lévy过程的快速无似然参数估计
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要 Lévy过程因能刻画高频资产收益数据中常见的跳跃性和厚尾性而被广泛应用于金融建模。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。本文提出一种快速且精确的Lévy参数估计方法，采用神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架——一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来逼近贝叶斯估计量。我们给出了新的理论结果，证明在温和条件下，NBE能够产生一致估计量，且其风险收敛于贝叶斯估计量的风险。此外，通过对多种Lévy模型进行大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能提供两种互补的不确定性量化途径。我们将该方法应用于一个具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集，结果显示该方法能够捕捉参数动态的演变，并以远低于传统方法的计算成本提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年间的高频比特币收益数据，使用所提方法估计参数所需时间不到一分钟。

socialSecurity.title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 住房供给弹性：一种结构向量自回归方法
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
                  我们采用带有符号限制的结构向量自回归模型，以识别正向需求冲击的影响，从而首次估算出覆盖全美各县（市）且随时间变化的住房供给弹性指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征。第一，住房供给弹性总体较低，导致全国大部分地区价格增速快于住房单元数量的增速。第二，各县（市）之间的弹性存在显著差异，无论城市还是农村皆然。第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县（市）数量多于上升的，尤其在大城市市场中更为明显。第四，相较于既有文献中的模型，这些新估算值对住房数量增长的预测能力更优。

socialSecurity.title: A Smooth Specification Test for the Propensity Score
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper proposes a simple smooth specification test for the propensity score in the spirit of Neyman (1937). We derive a particular restriction on the propensity score and construct the specification test based on it. Using the density‐weighting method, we transform the original specification testing problem into a test of the joint significance of the generalized Fourier coefficients. We propose a novel projection method to eliminate the parameter estimation effect arising from estimating unknown nuisance parameters. The proposed test is shown to follow a standard  distribution under the null hypothesis and to possess nontrivial asymptotic power against local alternatives that converge to the null at the parametric rate , where  is the sample size. To enhance the practical applicability of the procedure, we further introduce a data‐driven selection method for determining the testing order, enabling automatic selection based on the observed data. Compared to existing methods, our test does not suffer from the “curse of dimensionality” faced by Shaikh et al. (2009); at the same time, our test is both asymptotically pivotal and more computationally efficient than that of Sant'Anna and Song (2019). Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed test yields satisfactory empirical size and power. socialSecurity.titleZh: 倾向得分的一个光滑设定检验
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文在Neyman（1937）思想框架下，针对倾向得分提出了一种简单的光滑设定检验。我们推导了倾向得分的一个特定约束条件，并据此构建设定检验。借助密度加权方法，我们将原始设定检验问题转化为广义傅里叶系数联合显著性的检验。为消除由未知冗余参数估计所带来的参数估计效应，我们提出了一种新颖的投影方法。在原假设下，所提出的检验渐近服从标准分布，且对以参数速率（为样本量）收敛于原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡的渐近功效。为增强该程序的实际适用性，我们进一步引入了一种数据驱动的检验阶数选择方法，使其能够根据观测数据进行自动选取。与已有方法相比，本检验不存在Shaikh等人（2009）所面临的“维数灾难”问题；同时，相较于Sant'Anna和Song（2019）的方法，本检验不仅渐近枢轴化，而且计算上更为高效。大量模拟实验表明，所提出的检验具有良好的经验水平和功效。与既有检验相比，本检验整体性能相当，并在某些情形下（尤其是高频情形下）展现出明显的优势。

socialSecurity.title: Twin Defaults and Bank Capital Requirements
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    We examine optimal capital requirements in a quantitative general equilibrium model with banks exposed to nondiversifiable borrower default risk. Contrary to standard models of bank default risk, our framework captures the limited upside, but significant downside risk of loan portfolio returns. This helps to reproduce the frequency and severity of
                    twin defaults
                    : simultaneously high firm and bank defaults. Hence, the optimal bank capital requirement, which trades off a lower frequency of twin defaults against restricting credit provision, is higher than under default risk models which underestimate the impact of borrower default on bank solvency.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 双重违约与银行资本要求
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们在一个定量一般均衡模型中考察最优资本要求，其中银行面临不可分散的借款人违约风险。与标准的银行违约风险模型不同，我们的框架捕捉了贷款组合收益有限的上升空间与显著的下行风险。这有助于再现"双重违约"（即企业违约与银行违约同时高发）的频率与严重程度。因此，最优银行资本要求——在降低双重违约频率与限制信贷供给之间进行权衡——高于那些低估借款人违约对银行偿付能力影响的违约风险模型下的水平。

socialSecurity.title: Labor Market Institutions, Fiscal Multipliers, and Macroeconomic Volatility
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  How do labor market institutions shape the transmission of government spending shocks and macroeconomic volatility? We develop a theoretical model in which labor market institutions affect fiscal transmission through their effect on wage rigidity, job separation, and matching frictions. We estimate an interacted panel vector autoregressive model for 16 OECD economies and study how macroeconomic responses to government spending shocks vary with institutional labor market characteristics. In line with our theoretical predictions, we show that institutions that stabilize employment and wages tend to reduce output volatility and attenuate the response of output and employment to government spending shocks.

socialSecurity.title: Conditional Randomization Tests for the Specification of Interference Structure
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This study proposes specification tests for interference structure in causal inference with spillovers. We focus on experimental settings in which the treatment assignment mechanism is known. To test whether a given exposure mapping adequately summarizes the true interference structure, we develop conditional randomization tests by utilizing the hierarchical relationship between the null and alternative exposure mappings. When there are multiple candidate exposure mappings of interest, we propose a sequential specification testing procedure that controls the false discovery rate. Through extensive simulation exercises, we demonstrate that our tests have desirable size properties and satisfactory power. To illustrate the proposed methods, we revisit two existing social network experiments: One on farmers' insurance adoption and another on anti‐conflict education programs.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 干扰结构设定的条件随机化检验
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：本研究针对因果推断中具有溢出效应的干扰结构提出设定检验。我们关注处理分配机制已知的实验情境。为检验给定的暴露映射是否充分概括了真实的干扰结构，我们利用零假设与备择暴露映射之间的层次关系，发展了条件随机化检验。当存在多个候选暴露映射时，我们提出一种序贯设定检验程序以控制错误发现率。通过大量模拟实验，我们证明所提出的检验具有良好的水平性质和令人满意的检验功效。为说明所提方法的应用，我们重新审视两项已有的社会网络实验：一项关于农民保险采纳，另一项关于反冲突教育项目。

socialSecurity.title: Money Shortages and Complementary Currencies in Small Local Economies
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper rationalizes the adoption of a complementary currency (CC) in a small, local economy. A local money shortage occurs when the supply of official currency, determined endogenously by trade with a larger economy, falls short of the liquidity needed for first‐best activity. A CC then supplements liquidity and boosts local trade at the expense of external trade; the welfare‐maximizing CC supply is strictly positive. A calibration to coca‐growing villages in Colombia, where coca‐base circulates as a local CC, suggests its liquidity role raises local trade by roughly a third.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 小型地方经济中的货币短缺与补充货币
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文为小型地方经济中补充货币（CC）的采用提供了理论解释。当官方货币供给——由与更大经济体的贸易内生决定——不足以满足实现一阶最优活动所需的流动性时，便会出现地方货币短缺。此时，补充货币可补足流动性，以牺牲外部贸易为代价促进地方贸易；福利最大化下的补充货币供给严格为正。基于哥伦比亚种植古柯的村庄的校准分析表明，在这些村庄中古柯碱作为地方补充货币流通，其流动性功能使地方贸易量提升约三分之一。

socialSecurity.title: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We analyse fiscal policy in resource‐rich economies using a novel Bayesian regime‐switching panel model. The identified regimes capture pro‐ or countercyclical fiscal behaviour by allowing regime‐specific shifts in the average fiscal stance, while the switches between the regimes have the interpretation of changes in fiscal policy. Applying the model to a panel of sixteen oil‐producing economies, we show that fiscal policy has alternated between a procyclical and countercyclical regime multiple times over the sample. Furthermore, we find that fiscal policy is more volatile in the procyclical regime and that the probability of being in the procyclical regime is higher for OPEC countries than for non‐OPEC countries. We also show that following either an increase or decrease in oil revenues, the growth in government expenditures is mostly increasing, suggesting an upward bias in expenditures in oil‐producing countries. These are new findings in the literature.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 资源富裕经济体的财政政策体制
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们使用一种新颖的贝叶斯体制转换面板模型来分析资源富裕经济体的财政政策。所识别的体制通过允许平均财政立场的体制特定变化来捕捉顺周期或逆周期的财政行为，而体制之间的转换可被解释为财政政策的变化。将该模型应用于十六个石油生产经济体的面板数据，我们表明在样本期内财政政策在顺周期与逆周期体制之间多次交替。此外，我们发现顺周期体制下财政政策波动更大，且OPEC国家处于顺周期体制的概率高于非OPEC国家。我们还表明，在石油收入增加或减少之后，政府支出增长大多呈上升趋势，提示石油生产国存在支出向上的偏差。这些是文献中的新发现。

socialSecurity.title: Entrepreneurship and Financial Deregulation
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We quantitatively analyze the impact of US banking deregulation in the 1980s on the aggregate economy. Using recent econometric techniques, we first reexamine existing empirical evidence on the real effects of banking deregulation. We then construct a quantitative model that integrates imperfectly competitive banks into a general equilibrium framework of firm dynamics and occupational choice. Consistent with the empirical evidence, deregulation significantly increases output growth and firm entry. Increased competition among banks and the entrepreneurs' occupational choices play an important role in shaping the economy's response to deregulation.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 创业与金融放松管制
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文对美国1980年代的银行业放松管制对总体经济的影响进行了量化分析。我们首先运用最新的计量经济学方法，重新审视了关于银行业放松管制实际效应的现有实证证据。随后，我们构建了一个量化模型，将不完全竞争的银行整合到包含企业动态与职业选择的一般均衡框架中。与实证证据一致，放松管制显著提高了产出增长率与企业进入率。银行之间竞争加剧以及创业者的职业选择，在塑造经济对放松管制的反应中发挥了重要作用。

socialSecurity.title: Green Investing and Political Behavior
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractA fundamental concern about green investing is that it may crowd out political support for public policies addressing negative externalities. We examine this concern in a preregistered experiment conducted shortly before a real referendum on a climate law in Switzerland. We find that offering an opportunity to invest in a climate-friendly fund does not reduce individual support for climate regulation, measured by political donations and voting intentions. socialSecurity.title: Learning to Navigate a New Financial Technology
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We present results from a field experiment that introduced digital payroll accounts to unbanked factory workers to examine how inexperienced consumers learn to use a new financial technology. We find that exposure to payroll accounts leads to increased account use, accelerated learning, and avoidance of common consumer protection risks. Those receiving electronic wage payments gradually build trust in the technology, learn to use accounts without assistance, and avoid illicit fees. Using experimental variation in assignment to bank versus mobile money accounts, we show that these impacts are concentrated in mobile money accounts, the newer, more complex, and less trusted financial technology.

socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们报告一项田野实验的结果，该实验向未开立银行账户的工厂工人引入数字工资账户，以考察缺乏经验的消费者如何学习使用一项新金融技术。研究发现，接触工资账户能够提高账户使用率、加速学习进程并规避常见的消费者保护风险。获得电子工资支付的工人逐渐建立起对该技术的信任，学会在无协助的情况下使用账户，并避免遭遇非法收费。利用银行账户与移动货币账户之间随机分配的实验变异，我们发现，这些影响集中体现在移动货币账户上——作为一种更新颖、更复杂且公信力较低的金融技术，其效果尤为显著。

socialSecurity.title: Entry and Welfare in General Equilibrium With Heterogeneous Firms and Endogenous Markups
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We analyze market entry efficiency in single‐ and two‐sector closed‐economy Melitz–Ottaviano (MO) models without an outside good. Comparing market and second‐best outcomes, we find that market entry is efficient in the single‐sector model. This efficiency also holds in a symmetric two‐sector setting. When sectors have asymmetric demand and the level of asymmetry is sufficiently small, the market yields excessive entry into the “high‐demand” sector. This inefficiency arises from the presence of an additional aggregator in MO preferences.
socialSecurity.titleZh: Entry and Welfare in General Equilibrium With Heterogeneous Firms and Endogenous Markups

socialSecurity.title: Lurking Patent Claims and Strategic Royalty Contracts
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper analyzes optimal licensing contracts when a licensee faces the risk of future infringement claims by unknown patent holders. In a setting where a noncompeting licensor contracts with a monopolistic manufacturer, fixed‐fee licensing is optimal absent such claims. We show that the possibility of future patent claims makes it optimal to include a per‐unit royalty. The royalty reduces the surplus available to potential third‐party claimants and serves as a rent‐protection device, trading off allocative inefficiency against hold‐up risk. Restrictions on the contracting space can be justified when more realistic features of demand uncertainty or stochastic patent arrival are considered.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 隐伏的专利诉求与战略性特许权使用费合同
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文分析了在被许可方面临未知专利持有人未来侵权主张风险时的最优许可合同。在一个不竞争的许可方与垄断制造商签订合同的设定中，若不存在此类主张，固定费用许可是最优的。我们表明，未来专利主张的可能性使得在合同中加入单位特许权使用费成为最优选择。该特许权使用费减少了可供潜在第三方主张者攫取的剩余，并充当一种租金保护机制，在配置无效率与敲竹杠风险之间进行权衡。当进一步考虑需求不确定性或专利随机到达等更现实的特征时，对合同空间的限制亦可得到合理解释。

socialSecurity.title: Rational Expectations Fools' Bubbles
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We develop a rational, Walrasian model of speculative bubbles inspired by the Kindleberger–Minsky view, which describes bubbles as wave‐like market processes. Touched off by an initial shock, price booms are initially self‐reinforcing but become self‐destructive later when prices surpass fundamental value. Previous models in this vein have been criticized due to ad hoc features, such as prices driven by behavioral forces or particular trading protocols. Our model allays these concerns by relying only on multidimensional uncertainty to prevent unraveling via backward induction. Standard market clearing, moreover, makes the model more compatible with established macroeconomic and asset pricing frameworks.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 理性预期中的傻瓜泡沫
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要

我们构建了一个受金德尔伯格—明斯基观点启发的理性瓦尔拉斯投机泡沫模型，将泡沫描述为波浪式的市场过程。由初始冲击触发，价格繁荣起初具有自我强化特征，但当价格超出基本价值时便会转为自我破坏。先前类似模型因临时性设定而受到批评，例如价格由行为力量或特定交易协议驱动。本模型仅依赖多维不确定性来防止通过逆向归纳法导致的模型崩溃，从而消除了上述顾虑。此外，标准的市场出清机制使该模型与既定的宏观经济学和资产定价框架更加兼容。

socialSecurity.title: A Unified Approach to Estimating Production Functions: Proxy Variables and Dynamic Panel Data
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We propose a new approach to production function estimation that integrates the strengths of the proxy‐variable (PV) and dynamic panel data (DPD) methods. Our framework augments the set of instruments for the level equation in Blundell and Bond [8] with a Berkson‐type instrument motivated by economic theory, following Olley and Pakes [28], Levinsohn and Petrin [24], and Ackerberg et al. [4]. This modification allows unobserved productivity to include both a time‐invariant (“fixed‐effect”) component and a time‐varying component that follows a potentially nonlinear Markov process. Whereas the PV approach accommodates nonlinear Markov dynamics but not fixed effects, and the DPD approach accounts for fixed effects but only with linear Markov dynamics, our method relaxes both restrictions. Our estimator is straightforward to implement using GMM. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that it outperforms the canonical PV and DPD estimators when productivity persistence is low and fixed‐effect heterogeneity is substantial.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 一种估计生产函数的统一方法：代理变量与动态面板数据
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
我们提出了一种估计生产函数的新方法，该方法整合了代理变量（PV）方法和动态面板数据（DPD）方法的优势。我们的框架在 Blundell and Bond [8] 的水平方程工具变量集合中，加入了由经济理论驱动的 Berkson 型工具变量，遵循 Olley and Pakes [28]、Levinsohn and Petrin [24] 以及 Ackerberg et al. [4] 的思路。这一改进使得未观测的生产率既可包含一个不随时间变化的（"固定效应"）成分，也可包含一个服从潜在非线性马尔可夫过程的时变成分。PV 方法能够容纳非线性马尔可夫动态但无法处理固定效应，而 DPD 方法能够处理固定效应但仅限于线性马尔可夫动态，相比之下，我们的方法同时放宽了这两项限制。我们的估计量可以使用 GMM 简便地实现。蒙特卡罗模拟表明，当生产率持续性较低且固定效应异质性较大时，本方法优于经典的 PV 和 DPD 估计量。

socialSecurity.title: Opportunistic Upskilling in European Labour Markets—Evidence From a Wide Replication
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We build on Modestino et al., who analysed “opportunistic upskilling” during the 2007 recession in the US, by extending their approach to European labour markets following recent economic shocks. Using a comprehensive dataset of online job postings (2019–2023) and an instrumental variable approach leveraging Ukrainian refugee inflows, we find that increases in labour supply have a significant positive effect on both education and experience requirements. Our findings reinforce the idea that employers opportunistically upskill labour demand in different but challenging macroeconomic contexts. The identification of such patterns, however, depends on the presence of a plausibly exogenous shock to labour markets.
socialSecurity.titleZh: Opportunistic Upskilling in European Labour Markets—Evidence From a Wide Replication

socialSecurity.title: 跨境数据流动对企业创新的作用：基于贸易蕴含数据的检验
socialSecurity.abstract: 跨境数据流动是数字经济时代企业获取外部信息与提升创新能力的重要渠道，现有研究多聚焦数据直接流动的经济价值，较少研究间接数据流动的影响及作用机制。本文以2007-2016年我国海关进出口、国泰安上市公司研发创新数据库的合并数据为样本，通过构建由贸易通道实现的间接跨境数据流动的测度指标，并区分突破式与渐进式创新后考察了其对企业创新的影响。结果表明：贸易嵌入式的间接跨境数据流动显著促进了企业创新数量、总...

socialSecurity.title: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  College loans facilitate access to education, but the repayment burden may distort posteducation human capital investment. We examine the role of college loans and loan repayment policies through a structural model of individuals' dynamic decisions on borrowing/saving, labor supply, and costly human capital investment. We estimate two versions of the model using data from NLSY79: one with natural borrowing limits and another with parameterized limits. Counterfactual simulations suggest that, relative to the standard fixed repayment plan, income‐driven repayment (IDR) plans modestly increase educational attainment, lifetime earnings, and individual welfare; accounting for lifetime income taxes, they also increase government revenue.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 大学贷款与人力资本投资
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要 大学贷款有助于促进教育可及性，但还款负担可能会扭曲教育后的人力资本投资。本文通过构建一个关于个人借贷/储蓄、劳动供给以及成本性人力资本投资动态决策的结构性模型，考察大学贷款及其还款政策的作用。利用NLSY79数据，我们估计了该模型的两种版本：一种采用自然借贷限额，另一种采用参数化限额。反事实模拟表明，相较于标准的固定还款计划，收入驱动型还款（IDR）计划适度提高了受教育程度、终生收入和个人福利；若将终生所得税纳入考量，这些计划还能增加政府财政收入。

socialSecurity.title: A Cognitive Theory of Reasoning and Choice*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe present a theory of choice in which attention to the features of options is determined by the decision maker’s categorization of the current problem in a set of problems she solved in the past. Categorization depends on goal-relevant and contextual problem-level features. The model yields heterogeneity in attention and choice in a given problem based on different past experiences and instability when changes in irrelevant context cause recategorization. We show that heterogeneous and unstable representations of a choice problem unify major biases in judgment and decision making.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 推理与选择的认知理论
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们提出一种选择理论，其中决策者对选项特征的注意取决于其将当前问题归入其过去曾解决的一组问题中的方式。归类依赖于与目标相关的问题层面特征以及情境特征。该模型解释了面对同一问题时，由于过去经验的差异而产生的注意与选择的异质性，以及当无关情境变化导致重新归类时所出现的不稳定性。我们表明，决策问题中异质且不稳定的表征能够统一解释判断与决策中的主要偏差。

socialSecurity.abstract: 在碳中和转型背景下，本文构造我国“双碳”目标下的净零排放投资组合和转型风险衡量指标(DOR),该指标定义为企业从基准年至2060年保留在净零排放投资组合中的累计年数，DOR越低，企业前瞻性转型风险越大。本文以隐含权益资本成本作为投资者预期收益的代理变量，认为当投资者撤资高转型风险企业时，会提升其隐含权益资本成本，从而形成促进企业减排的市场约束机制。研究结果表明：(1)DOR增加显著降低了隐含权益资...

socialSecurity.title: 资产价格与通胀感知偏差——基于数字金融发展的再思考
socialSecurity.abstract: 准确度量通胀水平变化是平稳引导市场主体预期、实现价格稳定目标的前提和基础。近年来，随着资产市场快速发展和数字金融深度渗透，居民真实生活成本感知与宏观CPI指标之间的“温差”越发明显。本文以房价作为一类代表性资产价格，基于拓展的恩格尔曲线刻画了与房价变动相关的通胀感知偏差，从居民真实生活成本的角度对CPI进行修正。在此基础上，本文将数字金融发展因素纳入分析框架，考察其对房价相关的通胀感知偏差的影响。...

socialSecurity.title: 开“前门”是否有助堵“后门”?——地方政府专项债务发行对隐性债务举借的影响
socialSecurity.abstract: 本文基于2017—2022年地级市数据，研究地方专项债务发行对隐性债务举借的影响。结果发现，地方政府新增专项债发行减少了隐性债务规模，但每1元新增专项债发行仅带来0.72元的隐性债务下降。进一步利用融资平台承接专项债项目的数据分析发现，专项债项目的配套融资设计激励了地方政府增加隐性债务举借，使得专项债务对隐性债务的“替代效应”未达到1∶1。本文的研究表明，在增加专项债额度以满足地方政府合理举债需求...

socialSecurity.title: 双向奔赴：地级市专项债投资与省级五年规划
socialSecurity.abstract: 在“省级发行、市县使用”的专项债管理模式下，为了获得更高规模的专项债资金，地级市政府倾向于围绕省级重点发展领域谋划储备专项债项目。本文利用省级“十四五”规划与2018—2024年专项债项目层级微观数据，实证分析了省级五年规划对地级市专项债投资的引导效应。研究表明，省级“十四五”规划中重点布局的领域，获得了更高规模的专项债资金。这一引导效应在项目信息公开程度较低的地区、高公益性领域以及功能性产业政策...

socialSecurity.title: 针对地方政府违规举债问题的公开问责有效吗?——来自地方融资平台有息负债的证据
socialSecurity.abstract: 本文根据中央推动开展的针对地方政府违规举债的公开问责事件，评估在属地责任制度下的公开问责开展对隐性债务扩张的影响。研究发现：公开问责显著遏制了被问责城市的隐性债务扩张；同时，在属地责任制度下，公开问责还强化了该地所属省级政府的隐性债务管控力度，这有助于在同省其他城市中产生遏制隐性债务扩张的连带效应。机制分析表明，中央推动的公开问责通过两方面发挥作用：一是加强地方政府隐性债务监督治理，减少融资端违规...

socialSecurity.abstract: 在诸多企业组织形态中，个人独资企业在税收管理上具有特殊性，可能产生新形式的避税行为。本文在市场准入门槛降低的背景下，采用2012—2014年全国工商登记数据、企业招聘和税收调查匹配数据，结合DID研究思路，分析了商事制度改革对个人独资企业市场进入和纳税行为的影响。研究发现：(1)商事制度改革促进了个人独资企业进入市场，且这些企业保持较小规模形态。(2)内在机制在于改革降低了注册门槛并增加了行政许可...

socialSecurity.title: 司法专业化、债权保护与商业信用发展——来自审执分离改革的证据
socialSecurity.abstract: 本文聚焦债权“执行难”问题，基于2010—2021年上市公司数据，考察审判权与执行权分离改革对商业信用发展的影响。研究发现，审执分离改革显著提高了账款纠纷案件的执行质效，改善了政策实施地客户企业的商业信用获取能力，同时促使供应商增加对改革地客户企业的商业信用供给，在供需两端共同促进了商业信用发展。分组分析表明，审执分离对民营企业、低利润率企业、高信贷融资约束企业，以及信用环境不足和经济欠发达地区的...

socialSecurity.title: 产融合作试点、融资信心提振与劳动关系优化——来自裁判文书大数据的证据
socialSecurity.abstract: 构建和谐劳动关系是践行以人民为中心的发展思想、扎实推进共同富裕的重要基础。本文对中国裁判文书网中2013—2021年间的4334.8万篇判决书进行收集和整理，得到上市公司劳动争议诉讼案件数据，并根据“国家产融合作试点城市”政策的准自然实验，考察产融合作试点政策对企业劳动关系诉讼的影响。研究发现：首先，产融合作试点政策引导金融部门支持实体经济，降低了企业劳动关系诉讼案件数和金额数，有助于改善企业的劳...

socialSecurity.abstract: 准确度量通胀水平变化是平稳引导市场主体预期、实现价格稳定目标的前提和基础。近年来，随着资产市场快速发展和数字金融深度渗透，居民真实生活成本感知与宏观CPI指标之间的“温差”越发明显。本文以房价作为一类代表性资产价格，基于拓展的恩格尔曲线刻画了与房价变动相关的通胀感知偏差，从居民真实生活成本的角度对CPI进行修正。在此基础上，本文将数字金融发展因素纳入分析框架，考察其对房价相关的通胀感知偏差的影响。...

socialSecurity.abstract: 本文基于2017—2022年地级市数据，研究地方专项债务发行对隐性债务举借的影响。结果发现，地方政府新增专项债发行减少了隐性债务规模，但每1元新增专项债发行仅带来0.72元的隐性债务下降。进一步利用融资平台承接专项债项目的数据分析发现，专项债项目的配套融资设计激励了地方政府增加隐性债务举借，使得专项债务对隐性债务的“替代效应”未达到1∶1。本文的研究表明，在增加专项债额度以满足地方政府合理举债需求...

socialSecurity.title: What Determines State Heterogeneity in Response to U.S. Tariff Changes?
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We develop a structural framework to identify the sources of cross‐state heterogeneity in response to U.S. tariff changes. A unilateral 25‐percentage‐point U.S. tariff increase across sectors induces consumption changes ranging from −0.8% in Oregon to 2.3% in Montana. This variation stems from the interaction between states' internal comparative advantage and the nation's external comparative advantage. Factor mobility lowers aggregate consumption and reshapes the cross‐state impacts by shifting resources toward more distorted states and sectors. Consequently, preferred tariff changes vary systematically across states, necessitating transfers to align regional policy incentives. Foreign retaliation reduces aggregate gains while perpetuating cross‐state variation.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 决定各州对美国关税变化反应异质性的因素是什么？
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
我们构建了一个结构性框架，以识别各州对美国关税变化反应呈现跨州异质性的来源。假设美国对各部门单方面提高25个百分点的关税，所引发的消费变动幅度从俄勒冈州的−0.8%到蒙大拿州的2.3%不等。这一差异源于各州内部比较优势与国家外部比较优势之间的交互作用。要素流动不仅降低了总体消费水平，还通过将资源重新配置到扭曲程度更高的州和部门，重塑了跨州影响格局。因此，各州所倾向的关税变化方向存在系统性差异，这需要通过转移支付来协调区域间的政策激励。外国的报复性措施虽减少了总体收益，却使跨州差异持续存在。

socialSecurity.title: Multivariate Trend Inflation in the United States and the Euro Area
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  I provide a precision‐sampler‐based replication of the multivariate unobserved component stochastic volatility outlier‐adjusted model of Stock and Watson (2016) applied to inflation in the United States and the Euro Area (EA). I find a substantial post‐2020 increase in trend inflation for both the United States and the EA, and estimate end‐2024 trend inflation at 2.3 and 2.0 percent, respectively.

socialSecurity.abstract: 促进高质量充分就业，是新时代新征程就业工作的新定位、新使命。文章聚焦有工作经历的求职者考察其所经历的职业空窗对后续求职过程中企业雇佣决策的因果效应及边界条件。结合大规模在线招聘数据和随机化简历投递实验，文章实证分析显示，职业空窗对个人后续求职时企业的雇佣决策存在显著负向效应，且影响程度因职业中断原因而异：因考研或调休而辞职的负向效应较强，而因家庭原因中断职业的负向效应相对较弱；间隔时长本身的影响并...

socialSecurity.title: 中国老年人认知障碍与失能叠加的动态轨迹及预测研究
socialSecurity.abstract: 在老龄化和长寿背景下，认知障碍与失能相互叠加形成的“并发障碍”已成为影响老年人健康和长期照护需求的重要问题。文章基于2002～2021年中国老年健康和家庭幸福影响因素跟踪调查（CLHLS-HF）数据，构建涵盖健康、认知障碍、失能、并发障碍和死亡的五状态半参数马尔可夫模型，通过引入时间趋势和潜在公共因子，系统刻画老年人由单一障碍向并发障碍叠加演化的关键路径，并测算不同健康状态下的预期生存期及其变化趋...

socialSecurity.title: 中国老年人照料缺口的规模、特征与趋势
socialSecurity.abstract: 在快速老龄化与家庭结构深度变迁的背景下，中国老年人的照料缺口问题日益凸显。文章基于ProFamy家庭人口预测模型，系统预测2010～2050年中国老年人照料缺口的规模与结构变化趋势。研究结果表明，中国老年人照料缺口总体呈持续扩张态势，并在未来十至二十年进入快速增长阶段；照料缺口总体呈现向高龄、女性和城镇集中的趋势。值得注意的是，照料缺口广泛存在于各种家庭类型中，并非主要集中于无家庭支持的独居老人，...

socialSecurity.title: 《中国人口科学》投稿须知
socialSecurity.abstract: 《中国人口科学》是国家社科基金首批资助的学术期刊，是AMI权威期刊、CSSCI来源期刊、全国中文核心期刊、中国科技核心期刊，连续被中国知网评为中国最具国际影响力学术期刊。自1987年创刊以来，《中国人口科学》围绕人口及相关学科领域的重要议题发表了大量高质量、有影响的学术论文，是各界人士了解人口、经济等交叉学科发展的重要窗口，为国家和政府部门提供了科学决策依据

socialSecurity.title: 长期护理保险对家庭消费影响的代际传递效应
socialSecurity.abstract: 长期护理保险在保障亲代失能老年人身心健康的同时能否提升子代家庭消费，对扩大内需乃至畅通国内经济循环具有重要意义。文章采用2012～2022年中国家庭追踪调查数据，运用多期双重差分方法，检验长期护理保险对家庭消费影响的代际传递效应。研究发现，亲代参加长期护理保险能够显著提高子代家庭消费，且该结果通过了平行趋势检验和一系列稳健性检验。在影响机制上，亲代参加长期护理保险有助于减轻试点城市子代家庭的代际支...

socialSecurity.title: 投资于人：老年友好社区建设对老年消费的影响及机制分析
socialSecurity.abstract: 随着中国人口老龄化进程的加快，构建老年友好社区成为提升老年人生活质量和促进银发经济发展的重要举措。文章基于中国老年社会追踪调查（CLASS）数据，从空间可达性的视角，实证评估了老年友好社区建设对老年家庭消费的影响。研究发现，老年友好社区建设能够显著促进老年消费，优化老年消费结构，推动消费升级。机制分析表明，老年友好社区建设通过提升老年人健康感知、增加社会资本两条途径影响老年消费。异质性分析显示，低...

socialSecurity.title: 经济与心理双视角下就业稳定性与青年女性生育意愿——兼论生育支持政策的调节作用
socialSecurity.abstract: 文章基于2025年中国九省（市）青年女性婚育状况调查数据，从经济和心理双重视角研究就业稳定性对生育意愿的影响机制以及生育支持政策的调节作用。研究发现，不稳定就业和失业女性在未来两年内生育的可能性显著低于稳定就业女性。中介分析显示，不稳定就业和失业均会通过削弱女性的经济能力和养育信心降低其生育意愿，其中不稳定就业主要经由心理路径产生影响，而失业的经济与心理路径贡献相近。调节效应结果显示，经济补贴和带...

socialSecurity.title: Regularization of Synthetic Controls for Policy Evaluation
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We propose a unified framework for interpreting and comparing a broad class of synthetic control (SC) methods. Our framework is built on an analysis of a mean‐squared prediction error (MSPE) bound for the counterfactual predicted by a generic SC method, without imposing a specific outcome model. Using this framework, we develop a generalized SC method that provides a more comprehensive regularization of the MSPE bound than several existing SC methods. Through simulation studies and placebo analyses, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in predicting the counterfactual.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 政策评估中合成控制法的正则化
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个统一框架，用于解释和比较一类广泛的合成控制（SC）方法。我们的框架建立在对通用SC方法预测的反事实的均方预测误差（MSPE）界的分析之上，无需施加特定的结果模型。利用该框架，我们开发了一种广义的SC方法，与几种现有SC方法相比，它对MSPE界提供了更全面的正则化。通过模拟研究和安慰剂分析，我们证明了所提方法在预测反事实方面的有效性。

socialSecurity.title: Triply Robust Panel Estimators
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper studies estimation of causal effects in a panel data setting. We introduce a new estimator, the Triply Robust Panel (TROP) estimator, that combines  a flexible model for the potential outcomes based on a low‐rank factor structure on top of a two‐way‐fixed effect specification, with  unit weights intended to upweight units similar to the treated units and  time weights intended to upweight time periods close to the treated time periods. We study the performance of the estimator in a set of simulations designed to closely match several commonly studied real data sets. We find that there is substantial variation in the performance of the estimators across the settings considered. The proposed estimator outperforms Two‐Way‐Fixed‐Effect (TWFE) or Difference‐In‐Differences (DID), Synthetic Control (SC), Matrix Completion (MC) and Synthetic‐Difference‐In‐Differences (SDID) estimators. We investigate what features of the data generating process lead to this superior performance and assess the relative importance of the three components of the proposed estimator. We have two recommendations. Our preferred strategy is that researchers use simulations closely matched to the data they are interested in, along the lines discussed in this paper, to investigate which estimators work well in their particular setting. socialSecurity.titleZh: 三重稳健面板估计量
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
本文研究面板数据设定下的因果效应估计问题。我们提出了一种新的估计量——三重稳健面板（TROP）估计量，它将基于低秩因子结构叠加双向固定效应设定的潜在结果灵活模型与旨在对与处理单元相似的单元进行加权、同时对接近处理时点的时间段进行加权的时间权重相结合。我们在模拟实验中研究了该估计量的表现，这些实验设计紧密匹配多个常用的实际数据集。我们发现，在所考察的设定中，各估计量的表现存在显著差异。所提出的估计量优于双向固定效应（TWFE）或双重差分（DID）、合成控制（SC）、矩阵完备（MC）以及合成双重差分（SDID）估计量。我们考察了数据生成过程中的哪些特征导致了其优越表现，并评估了所提估计量三个组成部分的相对重要性。我们提出两点建议：我们首选的策略是，研究者应使用与其所关注数据紧密匹配的模拟（按本文所述方式进行），以探究在特定设定中哪些估计量表现良好；一种更简便的方法是采用更稳健的估计量，如 SDID 或本文新提出的 TROP 估计量，我们发现它们在很大程度上优于 TWFE。

socialSecurity.title: Estimation of Heterogeneous Panel Data Models With Mixed Sampling Frequencies
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper studies heterogeneous mixed‐frequency panel data models, focusing on linear specifications that allow heterogeneity in both aggregation weights and slope coefficients. To address potential correlations between the heterogeneity and the covariates, we first show that, under additional normalization conditions, the mean‐group estimator delivers consistent and asymptotically normal slope estimates but biased weights estimators. As an alternative, we propose a correlated random effects estimator using a generalized Mundlak specification. We further discuss the implementation of these two estimators when covariates are observed at substantially higher sampling frequencies. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to assess their finite‐sample properties. As an empirical illustration, we revisit the impact of temperature fluctuations on economic growth using the proposed framework.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 混合采样频率下异质性面板数据模型的估计
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究异质性混合频率面板数据模型，重点关注允许聚合权重和斜率系数同时具有异质性的线性设定。为应对异质性与协变量之间潜在的相关性，我们首先证明，在附加归一化条件下，均值组估计量能给出斜率系数的一致且渐近正态估计，但权重估计量却是有偏的。作为替代方案，我们提出一种使用广义Mundlak设定的相关随机效应估计量。我们进一步讨论了当协变量以显著更高的采样频率被观测时这两种估计量的实施问题。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估其有限样本性质。作为经验示例，我们利用所提出的框架重新考察了温度波动对经济增长的影响。

socialSecurity.title: A Demand Theory of the Price Level
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Heterogeneous agent incomplete markets models offer a new perspective on price and inflation determination. In contrast to complete markets, the price level is determined from the asset‐market clearing condition. Fiscal and monetary policy then jointly and uniquely determine the finite steady‐state price level and the inflation rate, including in a steady state in which the nominal interest rate is constant. Fiscal policy can determine the long‐run inflation rate for a fiscal rule which sets the growth rate of nominal government debt, whereas both fiscal and monetary policy determine the long‐run inflation rate under different tax rules.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 价格水平的需求理论
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：异质性主体不完全市场模型为价格与通货膨胀决定机制提供了新的研究视角。与完全市场不同，价格水平由资产市场出清条件决定。在稳态下，即便名义利率保持不变，财政政策与货币政策也能共同且唯一地决定有限的价格水平与通货膨胀率。当财政规则设定名义政府债务增长率时，财政政策可以决定长期通货膨胀率；而在不同税收规则下，财政政策与货币政策共同决定长期通货膨胀率。

socialSecurity.title: Make or Buy Decisions and Data Sharing
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Firms can share data to discover potential synergies between their data sets and algorithms, eventually leading to more efficient mergers and acquisitions (M&A) decisions. However, data sharing also modifies the competitive balance when firms do not merge, and a company may be reluctant to share data with potential rivals. Under general conditions, we show that firms benefit from (partially) sharing data. By doing so, they can merge conditionally based on high synergies. Compared to a laissez‐faire situation, the presence of a regulator allowing or refusing the M&A may increase or decrease data sharing, with a concomitant increase or decrease in consumer surplus. Hence, regulation can
                    reduce the surplus
                    of consumers it is willing to protect. We revisit the Google/Fitbit acquisition through the lens of this interplay between strategic data sharing and antitrust policy.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 自制或外购决策与数据共享
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 企业可以通过数据共享来发现其数据集与算法之间潜在的协同效应，从而最终做出更有效率的并购（M&A）决策。然而，即使在企业并未合并的情况下，数据共享也会改变竞争格局，因此企业可能不愿与潜在竞争对手共享数据。本文在一般条件下证明，企业能够从（部分）数据共享中获益。通过数据共享，企业可以基于高协同效应有条件地进行合并。相比于自由放任的情形，允许或拒绝并购的监管机构的存在可能增加或减少数据共享，并相应地增加或减少消费者剩余。因此，监管可能会降低其本欲保护的消费者剩余。本文以Google/Fitbit收购案为例，从战略数据共享与反垄断政策互动的角度重新审视该案例。

socialSecurity.title: Gender Criteria Gap in Evaluation: Role of Perceived Intentions and Outcomes
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    We investigate whether different criteria are used in evaluating male and female leaders when outcomes are determined by unobservable choices and luck. Evaluators form beliefs about leaders’ choices (perceived intentions) and make discretionary payments. We find that while payments to male leaders are determined by both outcomes and perceived intentions, those to female leaders are determined by outcomes only. We label this new source of gender bias as the
                    gender criteria gap
                    . Our findings imply that high outcomes are necessary for women to get bonuses, but men can receive bonuses for low outcomes if evaluators hold them in high regard.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 评价中的性别标准差距：感知意图与结果的作用
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们研究在结果由不可观测的选择和运气决定时，评价男性和女性领导者是否使用了不同的标准。评价者会形成关于领导者选择（感知意图）的信念，并做出酌情支付。我们发现，对男性领导者的支付由结果和感知意图共同决定，而对女性领导者的支付仅由结果决定。我们将这种新的性别偏见来源称为"性别标准差距"。我们的研究结果表明，高绩效是女性获得奖金的必要条件，而男性即使在低绩效下，只要评价者对他们评价较高，也可以获得奖金。

socialSecurity.title: International Reserve Management Under Rollover Crises*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis article investigates how a government should manage international reserves when it faces the risk of a rollover crisis. We ask: Should the government accumulate reserves or reduce debt to make itself less vulnerable? We show that the optimal policy entails initially reducing debt, followed by a subsequent increase in both debt and reserves as the government approaches a safe zone. Furthermore, we find that issuing additional debt to accumulate reserves can lead to a reduction in sovereign spreads. socialSecurity.titleZh: 展期危机下的国际储备管理
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究面临展期危机风险时政府应如何管理国际储备。我们提出的问题是：政府应当积累储备还是削减债务以降低自身脆弱性？我们表明，最优政策是首先削减债务，随后在政府接近安全区时同时增加债务和储备。此外，我们发现，通过发行额外债务来积累储备能够降低主权债券利差。新兴经济体面板数据的证据与上述预测一致。

socialSecurity.title: The Equilibrium Effects of Eviction Policies
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  I propose a dynamic equilibrium model of rental markets that endogenously gives rise to defaults on rents and evictions. In the model, eviction protections make it harder to evict delinquent renters, but higher default costs to landlords increase equilibrium rents. I quantify the model using micro data on evictions, rents, and homelessness. I find that stronger eviction protections exacerbate housing insecurity and lower welfare. The key empirical driver of this result is the persistent nature of risk underlying rent delinquencies. Rental assistance reduces housing insecurity and improves welfare because it lowers the likelihood that renters default ex ante.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 驱逐政策的均衡效应
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
                  本文提出了一个租赁市场的动态均衡模型，该模型内生地产生了租金违约和驱逐行为。在该模型中，驱逐保护政策使房东更难驱逐违约租户，但更高的违约成本会推高均衡租金水平。作者利用有关驱逐、租金和无家可归者的微观数据对模型进行了量化分析。研究发现，更强的驱逐保护政策反而加剧了住房不安全性并降低了福利水平。这一结果的主要经验驱动力是租金违约背后风险的持续性特征。租金援助能够降低租户事前违约的可能性，从而减少住房不安全性并提高福利水平。

socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe study rainmaking as an instrumental religious belief. We present a model in which a religious leader tries to persuade people to believe. Praying for rain can persuade only where the hazard of rainfall during a dry spell is increasing over time, so that prayer is most likely to succeed when people most want rain. socialSecurity.title: The Interaction Between Credit and Labor Market Frictions
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  I study a novel two‐way feedback between credit and labor market frictions. Running from credit to labor markets, amplitude in capital demand caused by collateral constraints spills over onto labor demand due to the complementarity of capital and labor; and, furthermore, credit frictions raise effective financial hiring costs, prompting firms to delay hiring in recessions. Running back from labor to credit markets, search frictions imply that wages move less than one‐to‐one with productivity; this induces greater volatility of net worth, via the wage bill, which then spills over onto capital demand. Together, these considerably amplify labor and capital market dynamics.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 信贷市场摩擦与劳动力市场摩擦的相互作用
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我研究了信贷市场摩擦与劳动力市场摩擦之间一种新颖的双向反馈机制。在从信贷市场向劳动力市场的传导方面，由抵押品约束所引起的资本需求波动，由于资本与劳动之间的互补性，会溢出至劳动需求；此外，信贷摩擦提高了有效的金融性雇佣成本，促使企业在经济衰退期推迟招聘。在从劳动力市场向信贷市场的反馈方面，搜索摩擦意味着工资的变动幅度小于与生产率的一比一对应关系；这通过工资成本引发了更大的净资产波动，进而溢出至资本需求。这两种机制共同显著放大了劳动力市场与资本市场的动态波动。

socialSecurity.title: Learning in the Limit: Income Inference from Credit Extensions
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Combining a randomized controlled trial with administrative and survey data, this paper shows that credit limit extensions significantly increase total spending and income expectations. By controlling for changes in personal income expectations, the spending response to credit limit extensions weakens by approximately 30%. For financially unconstrained consumers, expectation changes account for around two‐thirds of the spending responses to limit extensions. These findings are consistent with consumers inferring future income from credit supply.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 极限学习：从信贷扩展中推断收入
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文将一项随机对照试验与行政数据和调查数据相结合，表明信贷额度扩展显著提高了总支出和收入预期。在控制了个人收入预期的变化后，对信贷额度扩展的支出反应减弱了约30%。对于财务上不受约束的消费者而言，预期变化解释了额度扩展支出反应的三分之二左右。这些发现与消费者从信贷供给中推断未来收入的假设相一致。

socialSecurity.title: Why Doesn’t the United States Have National Health Insurance? The Political Role of the American Medical Association
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis article examines how the American Medical Association (AMA) helped shape the development of the U.S. health insurance system in the critical period after World War II. Working with the political public relations firm Campaigns, Inc., the AMA launched a nationwide campaign to weaken support for national health insurance by framing it as “socialized medicine,” while simultaneously enrolling people in private health insurance plans to shift demand away from a public alternative. socialSecurity.title: The Decentralization of Liquor Policies in Texas During the Post‐Prohibition Era
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We examine the decentralization of liquor policies in Texas during the Post‐Prohibition era using newly collected historical legislative roll call data. By combining these data with local referendum vote shares, we analyze both legislators' and constituents' preferences on liquor policy. We develop a probabilistic voting model incorporating spillovers and peer effects. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity in preferences among voters, reflecting differing attitudes toward alcohol regulation. Spillover effects are significant, yet the model predicts notable gains from decentralization. Finally, we link legislators' policy preferences to alcohol consumption data and compare model‐based welfare estimates with traditional consumption‐based measures.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 禁酒令之后时代德克萨斯州酒类政策的分权化
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文利用新收集的历史立法投票记录数据，考察了禁酒令之后时代德克萨斯州酒类政策的分权化。通过将这些数据与地方公投投票份额相结合，我们分析了立法者与选民众在酒类政策上的偏好。我们构建了一个包含溢出效应和同伴效应的概率投票模型。结果显示，选民偏好存在显著异质性，反映出对酒类监管的不同态度。溢出效应具有显著影响，但模型预测分权化能够带来显著收益。最后，我们将立法者的政策偏好与酒类消费数据相联系，并将基于模型的福利估计与传统基于消费的衡量标准进行了比较。

socialSecurity.title: Labor Market Monopsony Power and the Dynamic Gains to Openness Reforms
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We embed labor market monopsony into a dynamic heterogeneous‐firm general equilibrium model with exporting, horizontal FDI, and rich firm lifecycle dynamics. Rising marginal costs with monopsony slow and limit incumbent firm growth in response to liberalization, shifting adjustment to the extensive margin. Calibrated to US micro data, welfare gains from tariff reduction are over four times larger under monopsony than with perfect labor markets. The difference is mostly driven by new exporter creation and firm entry along the transition path. By contrast, lowering outward FDI taxes gives powerful quantitative welfare losses under monopsony, as firms undertake FDI to escape domestic wage pressure.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 劳动力市场买方垄断势力与开放改革的动态收益
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们将劳动力市场买方垄断嵌入一个包含出口、水平型对外直接投资以及丰富企业生命周期动态的异质性企业动态一般均衡模型中。在买方垄断条件下，边际成本随产出上升而递增，这减缓并限制了现有企业在自由化响应中的增长，使得调整主要发生在广延边际。模型以美国微观数据进行校准，结果显示在买方垄断条件下，关税削减带来的福利收益是完美劳动力市场条件下的四倍以上。这一差异主要由转型路径上的新出口商创建和企业进入所驱动。相比之下，在买方垄断条件下，降低对外直接投资税会带来巨大的量化福利损失，因为企业进行对外直接投资以规避国内工资压力。

socialSecurity.title: The Cost of Regulatory Compliance in the United States
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractA key question for studying business dynamism is whether the costs of regulatory compliance fall homogeneously on small and large businesses. Using comprehensive establishment-level occupational microdata and occupation task information, we quantify a firm’s compliance costs as the share of wage bill for performing regulatory compliance tasks (RegIndex). socialSecurity.titleZh: 美国的监管合规成本
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 研究商业活力的一个关键问题是监管合规成本是否同等地落在小型企业和大型企业身上。本文利用全面的企业级职业微观数据及职业任务信息，将企业的合规成本量化为用于执行监管合规任务的工资支出占比（RegIndex）。我们揭示了企业RegIndex与其规模之间呈倒U型关系：平均而言，约500名雇员的中型企业RegIndex比最小型企业高出约47%，比大型企业高出约18%

socialSecurity.title: Smokestacks and the Swamp
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe examine whether politicians affect local firms’ industrial pollution, and whether such effects are transmitted through plant-level networks to affect pollution in other regions. We first document that close Democrat wins in U.S. congressional races are associated with lower emissions and higher abatement at the plant level, especially when politicians have strong pro-environmental preferences. We also find evidence of reallocation: firms shift emissions away from areas represented by Democrats. However, reallocation is imperfect: firm-level costs are higher and market-to-book ratios
socialSecurity.titleZh: 烟囱与政治沼泽
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文考察政客是否会影响当地企业的工业污染，以及此类影响是否会通过工厂层面的网络传导，进而影响其他地区的污染。我们首先发现，在美国国会选举中，民主党以微弱优势获胜与工厂层面更低的排放和更高的污染治理相关，尤其是当政客具有强烈的亲环境偏好时。此外，我们还发现了污染重新配置的证据：企业将排放从民主党代表选区转移出去。然而，重新配置并不完全：企业层面的成本更高，且市净率（下降）……

socialSecurity.title: The Short and the Long of It: Stock‐Flow Matching in the US Housing Market
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  From 2006 until 2020, the probability of selling a house in the U.S. declined sharply after listing for 2 weeks. Moreover, sales within the first 2 weeks of listing (“quick sales”) and sales happening afterward (“slow sales”) behaved differently over the housing cycle. The probability and associated price of a quick sale recovered from the slump sooner, faster, and more prominently than a slow sale. This paper demonstrates that a calibrated stock‐flow matching model not only generates quantitatively consistent sales, prices, listings, and time on the market but also captures distinctions between fast and slow sales over the housing cycle.
socialSecurity.titleZh: The Short and the Long of It: Stock‐Flow Matching in the US Housing Market

socialSecurity.title: The Effects of Mandatory Profit-Sharing on Workers and Firms: Evidence from France
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractSince 1967, all French firms with more than 100 employees have been required to share a fraction of their excess profits with their employees. Through this scheme, firms with excess profits distribute, on average, 10.5% of their pretax income to workers. In 1990, the eligibility threshold was reduced to 50 employees. We exploit this regulatory change to identify the effects of mandated profit-sharing on firms and their employees. socialSecurity.titleZh: 强制利润分享对工人和企业的影响：来自法国的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 自1967年以来，所有员工超过100人的法国企业被要求将部分超额利润分配给员工。通过该计划，拥有超额利润的企业平均将税前收入的10.5%分配给员工。1990年，享受该计划的资格门槛降低至50名员工。我们利用这一监管变化来识别强制利润分享对企业及其员工的影响。强制利润分享对企业所造成的成本在改革前观察到的100名员工门槛处显著聚集现象中得以体现，该现象……

We acknowledge both points and thank the authors for pointing out these issues. The bargaining solution we use in Battisti et al. is the Kalai proportional bargaining solution with fixed surplus shares, not Nash bargaining. socialSecurity.titleZh: 移民、搜寻与再分配：对本地居民福利的定量评估——回复
socialSecurity.abstractZh: Stark和Byra指出了Battisti等人补充文件中资本收入计算的一个错误，并指出在存在工资税的情况下，我们的工资议价方程并不对应纳什议价解。我们承认这两点，并感谢作者指出这些问题。我们在Battisti等人中所采用的议价解是具有固定剩余份额的Kalai比例议价解，而非纳什议价解。在本回复中，我们证明：如果将模型校准至工资税率水平，则纠正该编码错误仅会带来较小的影响。

socialSecurity.title: How Does Progressivity Affect the Tax Cut Multiplier?
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  How does the targeting of personal income tax cuts affect the output multiplier? This paper provides quantitative evidence using a heterogeneous‐agent New‐Keynesian model calibrated to match US distributions of income, wealth, marginal tax rates, and marginal propensities to consume. Labor supply is determined by household preferences on the intensive margin and search frictions on the extensive margin. The model evaluates tax cuts for the bottom‐90 (B90%) and top‐10% of the income distribution in national and cross‐region settings, replicating influential empirical research designs. B90 tax cuts generate larger output effects while incentive effects play a central role in transmission.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 累进性如何影响减税乘数？
socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
个人所得税削减的针对性如何影响产出乘数？本文使用一个异质主体新凯恩斯模型提供定量证据，该模型校准以匹配美国的收入、财富、边际税率及边际消费倾向分布。劳动供给由家庭在密集边际上的偏好和广延边际上的搜寻摩擦共同决定。模型在国家层面和跨区域设定下评估针对收入分布后90%（B90%）和前10%的减税效应，复制了具有影响力的实证研究设计。研究发现，针对B90%的减税产生更大的产出效应，而激励效应在传导机制中发挥核心作用。

socialSecurity.title: Place‐Based Land Policy and Spatial Misallocation: Theory and Evidence From China
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We investigate a land policy in China that allocated more urban land quotas to underdeveloped regions to reduce regional gaps. Empirically, the policy decreased productivity in eastern areas relative to the inland. A spatial equilibrium model with migration, land quota constraints, and agglomeration shows the policy distorts labor and production across regions, causing substantial output losses. Though regional gaps narrowed, workers from underdeveloped areas migrated less and earned less. Without the policy, national output would have been 1.8% higher, and workers in underdeveloped areas would have earned 1.6% more in 2010. Regional transfers offer a less distortionary alternative for reducing inequality.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 区位导向的土地政策与空间错配：来自中国的理论与证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们研究了中国的一项土地政策，该政策向欠发达地区分配更多城市用地配额以缩小区域差距。实证上，该政策使东部地区的生产率相对于内陆地区有所下降。一个包含劳动力迁移、土地配额约束和集聚效应的空间均衡模型表明，该政策扭曲了跨区域的劳动力配置与生产，造成了巨大的产出损失。尽管区域差距有所缩小，但来自欠发达地区的工人迁移减少，收入降低。估计结果显示，若无该政策，2010年全国产出将高出1.8%，欠发达地区工人的收入将增加1.6%。区域转移支付是减少不平等的一种扭曲性较小的替代方案。

socialSecurity.title: Collusion with Optimal Information Disclosure*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractMotivated by recent concerns surrounding the use of third-party pricing algorithms by competing firms, we study repeated Bertrand competition where market demand or the cost of serving the market is observed by an intermediary (or “algorithm”) that selectively discloses demand or cost information to maximize firms’ collusive profit. We show that an upper censorship disclosure policy is optimal, which leads to price rigidity and supra-monopoly prices in some states. socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文受近期关于竞争对手使用第三方定价算法的担忧所启发，研究重复伯川德竞争，其中市场需求或服务市场的成本由中介（或称"算法"）观测，该中介有选择地披露需求或成本信息以最大化企业的合谋利润。我们证明上限审查披露策略是最优的，该策略在某些状态下会导致价格刚性并产生高于垄断水平的价格。提升算法的准确性在垄断定价情形下会降低期望消费者剩余，而在其他情形下亦如此。当

socialSecurity.title: Codification, Technology Absorption, and the Globalization of the Industrial Revolution
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis article examines the global adoption of technology in the late nineteenth century. We construct several novel data sets to test the idea that the codification of technical knowledge in the vernacular was necessary for countries to absorb the technologies of the first Industrial Revolution. We find that comparative advantage shifted to industries that could benefit from these technologies in countries and colonies with access to codified technical knowledge, but not in other regions. socialSecurity.titleZh: 技术编码化、技术吸收与工业革命的全球化
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文考察了19世纪后期技术的全球传播。我们构建了若干新的数据集，以检验以下假说：技术知识以本国语言进行的编码化是各国吸收第一次工业革命技术的必要条件。研究发现，在能够获取编码化技术知识的国家及殖民地，比较优势向能够受益于这些技术的产业转移，而在其他地区则未出现此现象。利用明治日本快速且史无前例的技术知识编码化作为自然实验，本文进一步验证了这一机制。

socialSecurity.title: “Compensate the Losers?” Economic Policy and the Origins of U.S. Partisan Realignment*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe argue that the Democratic Party’s evolution on economic policy helps explain partisan realignment by education. First, we document that educated Americans differentially oppose “predistribution” (e.g., job guarantees, higher minimum wages, protectionism, and stronger unions), while the educational gradient for redistribution (taxes and transfers) is close to zero. These relationships have been largely unchanged since the 1940s.
